title: FedHealth: A Research-Grade Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Framework for Distributed Clinical Healthcare
description: FedHealth is an open-source, production-grade federated learning and clinical AI framework designed for multi-institutional healthcare research. It incorporates non-IID optimization algorithms (FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedNova, FedAdam), mathematical Differential Privacy with exact Rényi DP accounting, empirical Membership Inference Attack (MIA) privacy validation, physiologically grounded Explainable AI (Cohort-Centroid Integrated Gradients), physics-informed Digital Twin hospital node simulation, and real-time telemetry analytics.
